items.text: Check that every screenshot shows the real app on that device size. iPad screenshots must come from an iPad, not a stretched iPhone screenshot.
items.why: Screenshots that do not show the app in use on that device are a common rejection.

items.text: Put your privacy policy link in App Store Connect as well as inside the app.
Give a demo account and password in the review notes if the app needs sign-in.
items.why: A reviewer who cannot get in rejects the app as incomplete.

items.text: Have a privacy policy that says what you collect and why, and a way for people to ask for their data to be deleted.
items.why: Privacy laws such as GDPR require it wherever you have users in Europe or the UK.
